_meta.provenance: Values as they stood in the class-era deconvolver on 2026-09-27, each with the measurement that set it. twin_r 0.985: CD4 vs CD8 marker-profile correlation is 0.978 and must NOT merge. cross_source_r 0.98: NK-cells_EPIC vs CD56_NK-cells sat at 0.984 and took 72 % of the non-blood mass in healthy blood (2026-09-26) - the same cell on another platform. min_separating_loci 30 / sep_delta 0.2: eosinophils vs neutrophils correlate at 0.990 yet 133 block loci separate them by > 0.2 beta - separable. cross_source coverage bounds 0.05 / 0.50: a source defined on < 5 % of the array against one on > 50 %. min_celltype_coverage 0.01: cells defined on < 1 % of the atlas (252-locus family) were filled with the grand mean and absorbed mass from every specimen (the erythroblast hub, 2026-09-26). n_celltype_markers_per_celltype 60: equal marker budget per cell so a 6,105-locus cell can win markers.
